description: This file declares functions related to the service indicator mechanism in BoringSSL's FIPS mode, including functions to update, lock, and verify service indicators, with inline no-op implementations for non-FIPS builds.

methods.name: FIPS_service_indicator_update_state
methods.description: Records that an approved service has been invoked; no-op in non-FIPS builds.

methods.name: FIPS_service_indicator_lock_state
methods.description: Locks the service indicator state to prevent updates; no-op in non-FIPS builds.

methods.name: FIPS_service_indicator_unlock_state
methods.description: Unlocks the service indicator state; no-op in non-FIPS builds.

methods.name: AEAD_GCM_verify_service_indicator
methods.description: Verifies service indicator for AEAD GCM; no-op in non-FIPS builds.

methods.name: AEAD_CCM_verify_service_indicator
methods.description: Verifies service indicator for AEAD CCM; no-op in non-FIPS builds.

methods.name: EC_KEY_keygen_verify_service_indicator
methods.description: Verifies service indicator for EC key generation; no-op in non-FIPS builds.

methods.name: ECDH_verify_service_indicator
methods.description: Verifies service indicator for ECDH; no-op in non-FIPS builds.

methods.name: EVP_Cipher_verify_service_indicator
methods.description: Verifies service indicator for EVP cipher; no-op in non-FIPS builds.

methods.name: EVP_DigestSign_verify_service_indicator
methods.description: Verifies service indicator for EVP digest sign; no-op in non-FIPS builds.

methods.name: EVP_DigestVerify_verify_service_indicator
methods.description: Verifies service indicator for EVP digest verify; no-op in non-FIPS builds.

methods.name: HMAC_verify_service_indicator
methods.description: Verifies service indicator for HMAC; no-op in non-FIPS builds.

methods.name: TLSKDF_verify_service_indicator
methods.description: Verifies service indicator for TLS KDF; no-op in non-FIPS builds.
